description: Browse the Collective Horology catalog, one brand collection, or specific watches, with price and availability filters.

availableOnly.description: Only emit products that currently have at least one variant in stock.
availableOnly.title: In stock only

brandFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the brand name, e.g. `ming`, `czapek`, `arcanaut`.
brandFilter.title: Brand

collectionHandle.description: Brand or collection slug, or paste its URL. Examples: `horologer-ming`, `czapek`, `armin-strom`, `https://collectivehorology.com/collections/fears`. Used in browseCollection mode. Approximate names such as `ming` are resolved automatically.
collectionHandle.title: Collection

condition.description: Filter by the condition tags Collective Horology publishes.
condition.title: Condition

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records (1–1000). Filters are applied before this cap.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Skip products priced above this amount.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD)

minPrice.description: Skip products priced below this amount.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD)

mode.description: Choose what to fetch from Collective Horology.
enumTitles: Look up specific products by handle or URL
mode.title: Mode

productHandles.description: Shopify product handles or full product URLs, one per line. Used in byProductIds mode.
productHandles.title: Product handles or URLs

productTypeFilter.description: Keep only one product type. Use `all` to include watches, straps, books and merchandise.
productTypeFilter.title: Product type

searchQuery.description: Keep only products whose title, brand, type, tags, description or SKU contain all of these words (case-insensitive).
searchQuery.title: Search words

sortBy.description: Order applied by Collective Horology before records are emitted.
sortBy.title: Sort order

title: Collective Horology Scraper Input
